senses.definition: n.pr.loc. (witness-pile) name of pile of stones erected by Jacob and his company (KitGesch. 129; by Laban We Di) Gn 31:47, 48 (v. גַּל 1 c) appar. intended to explain גִּלְעָד q.v.; Di conj. also (as name of altar) Jos 22:34 (cf. 𝔖).
